name: Bellmunt d'Urgell (Spain)
description: Red field with a black triangle along the lower edge with its apex at the centre, charged with a yellow hoopoe.
history: The official flag of Bellmunt d'Urgell is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with a black triangle along the lower edge with one angle at the hoist, another at the fly and the apex at the centre of the cloth, and with the yellow hoopoe of the arms; approved on 9 August 2012 and published in the DOGC on 12 September 2012.

features.role: triangle along the lower edge with its apex at the centre of the cloth
